title: al-agents-review: derive the target BC version from app.json
summary: The al-agents-review skill now derives the target Business Central version from app.json when not supplied by the orchestrator, reducing unknown version dimensions in standalone plugin reviews.
key_points: Agents articles are version-gated, so deriving version from app.json improves relevance
Allows findings to reach higher confidence levels instead of being capped at medium
Aligns al-agents-review with existing practices in al-query-review and al-reporting-review
No changes to READ semantics or other review skills
Resolves unknown version dimension in standalone plugin reviews
